summary: Tested Advisor on Call (Express + static HTML + ElevenLabs) end to end through the public URL. Backend: 5/5 pytest pass. /api/health returns {status:'ok', configured:true}. /api/get-voice-token returns a wss:// signedUrl with token equal to signedUrl, a new URL on each call, and the API key never appears in the response. Frontend: the initial state is correct (Start call / Ready when you are. / Offline). Start call with mic permission granted connected live to ElevenLabs: status went to 'Connected — go ahead and speak.' then 'Advisor is speaking…', the button changed to End call (red) and the indicator to Live. End call went back to Offline / Start call / 'Call ended.'. Two calls in a row both worked. Mic denial (getUserMedia rejected with NotAllowedError) shows 'Microphone access was denied.' in red. The mobile layout at 390px looks clean.

minor.issue: Unknown /api paths (e.g. /api/does-not-exist) return 200 with index.html because of the Express catch-all, instead of a JSON 404.
No rate limiting or abuse protection. Anyone can create signed URLs and use up agent minutes.
Preview-only proxy forwards only GET/POST and passes on only the content-type header. The Cache-Control: no-store header from Express is dropped in preview.

issues: The Offline dot uses --line (#e2ddd2) on #f5f2ec and is almost invisible.
Muted color #7b7a72 on #f5f2ec is about 4:1 contrast, a little under WCAG AA for the 12px footer text.

action_items: Optional: stop the tracks of the getUserMedia permission-check stream (stream.getTracks().forEach(t=>t.stop())) so it does not keep the mic open after the call ends.
Optional: pin the @elevenlabs/client version on esm.sh (it uses @0 now, which floats) so future SDK releases can't break the page.
Optional: return a JSON 404 for unknown /api routes, and make the Offline dot more visible.
critical_code_review_comments: index.html startCall: the MediaStream from getUserMedia({audio:true}) is never stopped. The SDK opens its own stream, so this one may keep the mic in use after the call ends.
The ESM import 'https://esm.sh/@elevenlabs/client@0' floats within major 0, where breaking changes are allowed. Pin an exact version.
onError only sets status text and does not reset live state. That is fine if onDisconnect follows, but nothing guarantees it.
server.js checks that the key is exactly 51 characters, which is brittle if ElevenLabs changes its key format.
test_credentials: No auth in the app. ElevenLabs keys are in /app/backend/.env (not printed).
context_for_next_testing_agent: No DB and no auth. Express runs on :3000 through the frontend supervisor. Ingress /api goes to FastAPI 8001, which proxies to Express. Granting the microphone permission in the Playwright context is enough to get a live ElevenLabs websocket call in headless Chromium. Mic denial was simulated by overriding getUserMedia to reject with NotAllowedError.
